name: mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase 1
pathways: positive regulation of protein serine/threonine kinase activity

function.text: MAP2K1 encodes dual specificity mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase 1. Annotated molecular activities include protein kinase activity and MAP kinase kinase activity. It participates in positive regulation of protein serine/threonine kinase activity and signal transduction.

germline.text: Retained constitutional disease associations include cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome (autosomal dominant); cardiofaciocutaneous syndrome 3 (autosomal dominant). Pathogenicity and inheritance depend on the specific allele and disorder.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Histiocytic sarcoma; Erdheim–Chester disease; Langerhans cell histiocytosis. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
